loops.name: Autonomy loop
loops.runbook_md: Stop: `touch /wd/loop/STOP`. Resume: remove the flag; loop-start.sh relaunches. Logs: /wd/loop/loop.log and /wd/loop/fires/fire-N.out.

loops.name: Slack watch
loops.runbook_md: Stamp: /wd/slack/last-watch (`TS new=N replies=N inbox=N`). A stale stamp means the autonomy loop is not firing.

loops.name: Hindsight seed
loops.runbook_md: Stamp: /wd/hindsight-seed.stamp (`seeded_at=`, `items=`, `bank:<name>=N`). Re-seed by removing the stamp and restarting.
